description: Free. Fetches an x402 seller's 402 quote without paying and returns latency, HTTP status and the quoted price per chain, plus a dry-run test-buy plan checked against the kit's local caps (default 0.01 per buy, 0.05 per day per asset). Nothing is signed or paid from this tool. Passive mode is the default way to contribute: report purchases you already made with lumi_report_receipt.
